name: @w6w-apps/shippo
description: Rate a parcel across every carrier, buy the label, track it to the door, and validate addresses before a bad one costs a return.

w6w.longDescription:
Shippo rates a parcel across every carrier account on the connection, buys the label, tracks it to the door, and validates an address before a bad one turns into a costly return. Rating and buying are deliberately separate steps: creating a shipment only asks Shippo's connected carriers for a price and issues nothing, while purchasing a label is what actually moves money and produces a tracking number — so a workflow that only wants a quote never risks buying one by accident.

Tracking status is read for what it actually means rather than taken at face value: an unscanned parcel reads as pre-transit or unknown rather than lost, and the two statuses that need a human's attention — returned to sender and carrier failure — are distinct values rather than blended into everything else. Address validation runs as its own cheap step ahead of purchase, returning Shippo's corrected version of an address so a mismatch is caught before a label is printed rather than after a parcel comes back.

Beyond shipping, this app can also refund an unused label, register or read tracking for a number bought outside Shippo, and list the carrier accounts connected to the account. Registering new carrier accounts, orders, batches, manifests and webhook management are left out, since those are dashboard-level or platform-account decisions rather than steps in an automation.
